messages:
rachel: PSA: someone emptied the office staple dispenser and left the box under the plant. who did this? 

paul: not me. but if it was me, i'd claim it was a performance art piece called 'Minimal Staples.' :art:

nina: i nominate we create a ritual to welcome returned staples. tiny ceremony, spoken vow.

sven: i caught a shadow near the printer last night. heard a soft metallic whisper. could be the Staple Thief.

supply-bot: Supply alert: Low on staples. Automatic reorder placed for 2 boxes. Expected delivery 2 business days.

rachel: thank you supply-bot. also thinking of creating a "Staple Steward" rotation to prevent future heists.

paul: honors for the Staple Steward include a laminated badge and one miniature stapler.

nina: also awarding an honorary nickname: "Staplemaster General." need votes. react :thumbsup: to approve.

sven: vote: :thumbsup: from me. bring on the badge.

rachel: tally: two votes in favor. if no objections by EOD, steward rotation goes live.

paul: objection: we must make initiation challenging. candidate must staple three pages with one hand while reciting the company values.

supply-bot: Please note: Safety first. Do not attempt stapling stunts that may cause harm. This is an automated safety reminder.

nina: fine, toned-down initiation: dramatic reading + correct staple alignment. classy.

sven: also proposing a commemorative plaque above the printer: "In memory of lost staples, found community." too corny?

rachel: perfect. i'm ordering the badge and a tiny plaque. will post ceremony time.

paul: great. also can we please stop the person who hides the tape dispenser. that one is personal.

supply-bot: Reminder: To report missing communal supplies, use /supply ticket <item>. This is an automated message.

rachel: thanks all. the Staplemaster General shall be crowned next Friday. bring your best stapling hand.
__notes: Single Slack thread string; messages are chronological and each is prefixed by sender display names. No title field included per agents.md.
